title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 17 October 2026
description: The Bell Bay Aluminium smelter's future is secured through 2031 with a $200M support package and new power deal, Queensland's Cross River Rail reaches a visible construction milestone at Albert Street station, and the Gold Coast opens the first stage of its Greenheart Robina Parklands. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
